title: Same Bench Clips
eyebrow: Same Bench · clips round 1 (Omni 1.2 Flash, 6 s, 9:16)
heading: The three clips
intro: Your three animation picks, made in Flow. Pick Keep or leave a note per clip; a note becomes a re-roll. The dates, plaque words and caption come later in the edit, and so does the voice.

sections.lede: Checked frame by frame before this page.

groups.title: A. 1919: he flicks the soldier away

opts.label: A (anim 1a)
opts.warn: Good: lips never move, the soldier limps out on his crutch; his legs are lost in shadow, so the missing leg doesn't read clearly

groups.title: B. 2026: the same flick, the nurse walks off

opts.label: B (anim 2a)
opts.warn: Good: same flick, she walks off towards the hospital, ambulance light behind

groups.title: C. He turns to the empty seat
groups.line: Caption: "Same bench." then iris to black

opts.label: C (anim 3b)
opts.warn: ⚠ As he turns, his eyes come out of the shadow and his face changes to a more ordinary man: the horror look slips. A re-roll or a cut before the turn finishes would fix it
